dialogues.speaker: Lilian
dialogues.text: Hehe, I've got a good nose. You're wearing one of Miss Annick's fragrances, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Lilian
dialogues.text: The notes are rich and well-layered, with clear transitions. The whole scent comes together so perfectly... It feels like the winter sun at midday. Bright, but gentle.

dialogues.speaker: Lilian
dialogues.text: Thank you. This fragrance of yours... It's given me a fresh wave of inspiration.
